caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition divided into six vertical panels of equal width. Each panel contains an ornate floral and foliage pattern outlined in black. The panels alternate in three main background colors: muted gold-yellow, light bluish-green, and off-white. The gold-yellow panels are filled with repeated flower and leaf motifs, as are the blue-green and white panels, each containing similar but distinct patterns. Surrounding the vertical panels are decorative horizontal borders at the top and bottom. These borders are filled with a repeating floral and curvilinear vine design primarily in yellow, black, and gray. The overall palette of the drawing includes black, yellow, bluish-green, gray, and white. The drawing uses bold black outlines throughout and features some shading and color washes to fill the spaces inside the patterns. In the bottom left corner, the number "22" is written in small, black print.
title: Plate 22: Wall Decoration, Laguna: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
